title: Concept: Sentry console is reachable without authentication
description: An error tracker concentrates the failures of an application: stack traces with file paths, request headers with cookies, and the user identifiers attached to each event. Reading it is reading what the application leaks when it breaks.
applicability: Responses that serve a self-hosted error tracker on the application host.
risk: The caller reads exception history with its request context, including headers and identifiers that were never meant to leave the server.
